v4.you_re_paid_directly_by_the_broker_or_th: You're paid directly by the broker or through your factoring company — money never passes through us. We prepare and submit the invoices and paperwork so nothing delays your settlement.
v4.you_see_every_rate_con_what_the_broker_p: You see every rate con. What the broker pays is what you see.
v4.your_account_is_suspended_call_908_404_5: Your account is suspended. Call (908) 404-5373 or email support@pickloads.com to resolve it.
v4.your_account_isn_t_linked_to_a_carrier_r: Your account isn't linked to a carrier record yet. If you just onboarded, our team activates the link during document review — or call (908) 404-5373.
v4.your_account_isn_t_linked_to_a_company_r: Your account isn't linked to a company record yet, so there are no shipments to show. Call (908) 404-5373 and we'll link it — your quotes are already matched by your sign-in email.
v4.your_account_was_set_up_by_our_team_and_: Your account was set up by our team and isn't linked to a company record yet — quotes are matched by your sign-in email. Call (908) 404-5373 to link it.
v4.your_dispatch_back_office_document_revie: Your dispatch back office: document review, agreement status and your loads — in one place.
v4.your_dispatcher_learns_your_lanes_your_r: Your dispatcher learns your lanes, your rate floor and your home-time needs — then gets to work.
v4.your_dispatcher_plans_lanes_around_these: Your dispatcher plans lanes around these — update them any time.
v4.your_mc_application_is_pending_our_team_: Your MC application is pending — our team verifies it and activates dispatch. Sign in any time to track your documents.
v4.your_mc_dot_authority_a_w_9_a_certificat: Your MC/DOT authority, a W-9, a certificate of insurance ($1M auto liability / $100K cargo) and a voided check or factoring notice. Setup takes about 5 minutes; most carriers get their first load within 24 hours.

page.title: Track a shipment
page.intro: Enter your PickLoads tracking number and the delivery ZIP code — or the access code from your confirmation — to see where your freight is.
page.meta_description: Track a PickLoads shipment with your tracking number and delivery ZIP code. Milestone updates entered by our dispatch team — no account needed.
page.gate_notice: PickLoads brokerage shipments begin once our FMCSA broker authority and BMC-84 bond are active. If you are a dispatch customer, your loads are tracked inside the Carrier Portal.
page.help_body: Your tracking number is on your confirmation email and on the bill of lading. If the delivery ZIP code doesn't work, try the access code from the same email. Still stuck? Call (908) 404-5373 — a dispatcher answers 24/7.
page.privacy_note: We ask for two pieces of information because a tracking number on its own is not a password. We log every lookup attempt.

form.secondary: Delivery ZIP code or access code

driver.title: Shipment update
driver.intro: Tap what just happened. Dispatch sees it straight away.
driver.no_money: This page never shows rates, invoices or anything about the customer's price.
driver.honest_note: Updates are what you type here. This page does not track your phone and does not show a live GPS position.

driver.reported: Reported. Dispatch will call you if they need more.

driver.consent_checkbox: Share the city and state I type

driver.exception_note: Dispatch decides how urgent this is and tells the customer.

carrier.title: Shipments
carrier.intro: Brokerage freight assigned to you. Update a shipment here, or send your driver a link.
carrier.gate_notice: Brokerage shipments start once our FMCSA broker authority and BMC-84 bond are active. Your dispatch loads are on the Loads page, not here.
carrier.no_record: Your account isn't linked to a carrier record yet. Our team activates the link during document review — or call (908) 404-5373.

carrier.links_body: A driver link lets one driver update this one shipment from their phone, with no account. It expires on its own, you can revoke it at any time, and it never shows money.
carrier.links_once: The link is shown once, when you create it. We store only a fingerprint of it, so it cannot be looked up again — create a new one instead.

optout.title: Shipment update emails
optout.intro: Turn off the emails we send as your freight moves. Your shipments keep updating in the portal and on the tracking page.
optout.invalid: This link isn't complete or is no longer valid. Email support@pickloads.com and we'll update your preferences by hand — no account needed.
optout.unavailable: We can't reach your preferences right now, so nothing was changed. Try again in a few minutes, or email support@pickloads.com.
optout.confirm: Confirm below and we'll stop emailing you shipment updates for this address. This takes effect immediately.
optout.already: Shipment update emails are already off for this address — nothing more to do.
optout.stopped: ✓ STOPPED — We will not email you shipment updates at this address.
optout.resumed: ✓ RESUMED — Shipment update emails are on again for this address.
optout.scope_note: This only covers shipment update emails. Freight Insights (our newsletter) has its own unsubscribe link, and account, billing and support emails you asked for keep working.
